data.content_ref: inline:The target's defense relies on the concept of 'likelihood of immediate error,' which smuggles in the very probabilistic induction Popper rejected. In a strict Popperian framework, all unfalsified theories have equal logical standing regarding future truth; asserting that one carries a higher 'likelihood' of error is an inductive claim about the future based on past performance, not a deductive consequence of corroboration.
